nodes.label: Absolute Minimal Changes Principle
nodes.rationale: AI-assisted edits should change only the exact lines needed to fix the reported issue, preserving existing style/patterns, to avoid scope creep, unrelated regressions, and hard-to-review diffs when an agent edits this async SMPP codebase.
